form.div: Creates a working firm: clients, opposing parties, cases across every type and stage, hearings past and future, statutory deadlines, documents at each review step, engagements with recorded time and expenses, and client trust deposits. Generation is seeded, so the same database always produces the same firm.
Test data is already loaded. Loading again adds a further batch on top; use Remove to clear what is there first.

Try the client portal: two logins ship with the data, password PortalDemo!2026 for both.
client.demo@example.sa — a client with several cases: hearings, shared documents, invoices and trust money.
opponent.demo@example.sa — the other side of seven cases, who correctly sees none of them: that emptiness is the security boundary working, not a bug.

button.name: action_purge
button.confirm: This permanently deletes every record created by the test-data loader. Continue?
